A '''battle''' took place on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Belsus/Legends|Belsus]]<ref name="GG 4">[[General Grievous 4|''General Grievous'' 4]]</ref> in [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]],<ref name="TNEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> when a small group of [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] led by [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Flynn Kybo]] undertook an unsanctioned mission to assassinate [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist Alliance]]. The mission failed, and Kybo was [[Death/Legends|killed]] during the battle.<ref name="GG 4" />
